{
  "tool": "code_write_file",
  "args": {
    "path": "ci-cd/deploy_cloud_run.sh.template",
    "content": "#!/bin/bash

# deploy_cloud_run.sh.template
# This script automates the deployment of a containerized service to Google Cloud Run.
# It is designed to be called from a CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Cloud Build) or manually.

# Exit immediately if a command exits with a non-zero status.
set -e

# --- Configuration Variables ---
# These variables can be overridden via environment variables or command-line arguments.
# Default values are provided for convenience.

SERVICE_NAME="${SERVICE_NAME:-my-service}"
PROJECT_ID="${PROJECT_ID:-$(gcloud config get-value project)}"
REGION="${REGION:-us-central1}"
IMAGE_TAG="${IMAGE_TAG:-latest}"
IMAGE_REPO="${IMAGE_REPO:-gcr.io/${PROJECT_ID}/${SERVICE_NAME}}"
# The full image path: e.g., gcr.io/my-project/my-service:latest
FULL_IMAGE_PATH="${IMAGE_REPO}:${IMAGE_TAG}"

# Cloud Run specific settings
MEMORY="${MEMORY:-512Mi}"
CPU="${CPU:-1}"
CONCURRENCY="${CONCURRENCY:-80}"
MIN_INSTANCES="${MIN_INSTANCES:-0}"
MAX_INSTANCES="${MAX_INSTANCES:-10}"
ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED="${ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED:-false}" # 'true' or 'false'

# Service Account for the Cloud Run Revision. Must have necessary permissions.
# By default, use the project's default compute service account.
SERVICE_ACCOUNT="${SERVICE_ACCOUNT:-$(gcloud projects describe ${PROJECT_ID} --format='value(projectNumber)')-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com}"

# Environment variables to set (e.g., "VAR1=value1,VAR2=value2")
ENV_VARS="${ENV_VARS:-}"

# Secrets to set (e.g., "VAR_NAME=SECRET_ID:VERSION")
SECRETS="${SECRETS:-}"

# --- Helper Functions ---
log_info() {
  echo "[INFO] $1"
}

log_error() {
  echo "[ERROR] $1" >&2
}

# --- Argument Parsing (Basic) ---
# This allows overriding variables via command line, e.g., ./deploy.sh --service-name=my-app
for i in "$@"; do
  case $i in
    --service-name=*)
      SERVICE_NAME="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --project-id=*)
      PROJECT_ID="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --region=*)
      REGION="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --image-tag=*)
      IMAGE_TAG="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --image-repo=*)
      IMAGE_REPO="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --memory=*)
      MEMORY="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --cpu=*)
      CPU="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --concurrency=*)
      CONCURRENCY="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --min-instances=*)
      MIN_INSTANCES="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --max-instances=*)
      MAX_INSTANCES="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --allow-unauthenticated=*)
      ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --service-account=*)
      SERVICE_ACCOUNT="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --env-vars=*)
      ENV_VARS="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    --secrets=*)
      SECRETS="${i#*=}"
      shift # past argument=value
      ;;
    -*|--*)
      log_error "Unknown option $i"
      exit 1
      ;;
    *)
      # positional arguments not supported for now
      ;;
  esac
done

log_info "Starting Cloud Run deployment for service: ${SERVICE_NAME}"
log_info "Project: ${PROJECT_ID}"
log_info "Region: ${REGION}"
log_info "Image: ${FULL_IMAGE_PATH}"

# --- Construct gcloud command ---
CMD="gcloud run deploy ${SERVICE_NAME}"
CMD+=" --image=${FULL_IMAGE_PATH}"
CMD+=" --platform=managed"
CMD+=" --region=${REGION}"
CMD+=" --project=${PROJECT_ID}"
CMD+=" --memory=${MEMORY}"
CMD+=" --cpu=${CPU}"
CMD+=" --concurrency=${CONCURRENCY}"
CMD+=" --min-instances=${MIN_INSTANCES}"
CMD+=" --max-instances=${MAX_INSTANCES}"
CMD+=" --service-account=${SERVICE_ACCOUNT}"

if [ "${ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED}" = "true" ]; then
  CMD+=" --allow-unauthenticated"
else
  CMD+=" --no-allow-unauthenticated"
fi

if [ -n "${ENV_VARS}" ]; then
  CMD+=" --set-env-vars=${ENV_VARS}"
fi

if [ -n "${SECRETS}" ]; then
  CMD+=" --set-secrets=${SECRETS}"
fi

# --- Execute Deployment ---
log_info "Executing command: ${CMD}"
eval ${CMD}

log_info "Cloud Run deployment for ${SERVICE_NAME} completed successfully."
"
  }
}
